observations.scope: Real Flutter analysis/auth clients and own TCP/API/Postgres; injected availability/rejection only. Five samples/variant describe error completion, not reliable tail percentiles, SLA or speedup.

correction.change: Handle transient HTTP status before decoding the body

limits: Five observations per variant are completion-time probes, not reliable tails, confidence bounds or speedup evidence.
Actual Flutter AnalysisApiService/AuthApiService, TCP, auth refresh and PostgreSQL; inference/availability faults controlled, no physical device or paid AI.
Callbacks bridge actual AuthApiService refresh; SessionStore secure-storage/race behavior is covered in its separate existing suites.
